Coverage: all 92 current directory pages, 2,295 unique review entries. Includes restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and bars; each reviewed branch remains separate. A few city-label errors were normalized using source addresses and coordinates; SFO Airport is outside the SF filter. 5 entries have no Infatuation price. Blank scores or counts are unavailable, not zero. Google results are matched by name and address or location; ambiguous results stay unassigned. Expand “Google match” to see the matched listing and any address difference. Google ratings and review counts change over time; each record includes its lookup timestamp. Map locations use matched Google coordinates where available; amber dots use approximate Infatuation review coordinates. Map tiles require an internet connection. Inclusion does not verify that a restaurant is still open.
